items.definition:
a person's fixed, permanent, and principal home for legal purposes
His legal domicile is in New York, even though he travels frequently.

intense and passionate feeling
The crowd cheered with great fervour for their team.

a leave of absence, especially from military duty or for a government employee
Many employees were sent home on furlough during the economic downturn.

sly or cunning intelligence
He used his guile to outsmart his opponents.

A planet or world from which a species or individual originates.
The aliens were trying to return to their homeworld.

A failure to observe standards or show due honesty or modesty; improper behavior.
The politician was accused of financial impropriety.

The process of making something inactive or ineffective.
The inactivation of the enzyme was crucial for the experiment.

The burial of a corpse in a grave or tomb, typically with funeral rites.
The family gathered for the interment of their loved one.

An expert in law; a legal scholar.
The esteemed jurist delivered a lecture on constitutional law.

The state, office, or dignity of a king.
The young prince was being prepared for kingship.

the jaw or a jawbone, especially the lower jawbone in mammals and fish
The paleontologist examined the dinosaur's powerful mandible.

the scientific study of minerals
She specialized in mineralogy during her geology studies.

the practice or state of being married to one person at a time
Many cultures traditionally practice monogamy.

an examination of a dead body; an analysis after an event
The team held a postmortem meeting to discuss the project's failure.

a soft boggy area; a difficult or complex situation
The project quickly turned into a financial quagmire.

a state of rest, sleep, or tranquility
She found a moment of repose in the quiet garden.

the use of dexterity or cunning, especially to deceive
The magician performed a trick with great sleight of hand.

an artist or writer who practices surrealism
Salvador Dalí is a famous surrealist painter.

hypothetical instantaneous travel
In science fiction, teleportation allows characters to move instantly from one place to another.

a brilliant red pigment
The artist used a vibrant vermilion to paint the sunset.

a small fluid-filled sac in the body
The microscope revealed tiny vesicles transporting proteins within the cell.

a person who advocates or supported the abolition of slavery
Harriet Tubman was a famous abolitionist who helped slaves escape to freedom.

the hypothetical medium formerly believed to fill all space
Ancient philosophers believed in a celestial aether that filled the heavens.

a person who prepared and sold medicines and drugs
The apothecary carefully measured the herbs for the remedy.

the process of evaluating something by comparison with a standard
Benchmarking helps companies improve their performance.

a foolish or stupid person
Don't be such a berk; think before you speak.

a term of address for a man, especially in South Africa; brother or friend
Hey, bru, how's it going?

a concluding passage of a piece or movement, typically forming an addition to the basic structure
The final movement ended with a powerful coda.

a medical procedure to examine the colon
He had a colonoscopy as part of his routine check-up.

a direct or natural consequence or result
Increased pollution is a natural corollary of industrial growth.

a factor, force, or influence that offsets or acts against another
The new policy serves as a counterbalance to the previous one.

the action of treating something sacred with violent disrespect
The desecration of the ancient temple caused outrage.

An escape of blood from a ruptured blood vessel, or a rapid and uncontrollable loss or outflow.
The company suffered a haemorrhage of talent after the merger.

An apparatus for burning waste material.
The city plans to build a new incinerator for waste disposal.

Jewish people collectively
The history of Jewry is rich and complex.

a subsidiary proposition assumed to be true in order to prove another proposition
The proof of the theorem relies on a crucial lemma.

a microscopic tube made of carbon atoms
Carbon nanotubes have unique electrical and mechanical properties.

the rejection of all religious and moral principles
His philosophy was rooted in a deep sense of nihilism.

the arrangement of a musical composition for an orchestra; the careful organization of something
The orchestration of the new symphony was complex and beautiful.

a low protective wall along the edge of a roof, bridge, or balcony
The soldiers took cover behind the castle's stone parapet.

a city-state in ancient Greece
Athens was a powerful polis in ancient Greece.

a structure consisting of a roof supported by columns, forming a porch or entrance
The grand building had a large portico supported by Doric columns.

the production of offspring; reproduction
The primary biological purpose of mating is procreation.

the state of being under the control of a receiver, typically due to financial difficulties
The company went into receivership after failing to meet its financial obligations.

brought back; revived (often used in titles)
The director released a new version of the film, titled 'Apocalypse Now Redux'.

the occurrence and development of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way
It was pure serendipity that they met at the airport after so many years.

a puff of a cigarette or marijuana
He took a long toke from his cigarette.

the soft underside of an animal; the vulnerable or unpleasant part of something
The documentary exposed the underbelly of the city's crime world.

the quality of being impossible to foresee or predict
The unpredictability of the weather made planning difficult.

a hollow part or cavity in an organ, in particular a brain or heart
The heart has two main ventricles.

the external female genitalia
The vulva is part of the female reproductive system.

a medieval weapon consisting of a hammer with a pick or spike on the other side
The knight wielded a heavy warhammer.

magic; sorcery
The magician's performance was full of incredible wizardry.

the reduction or elimination of something
The city ordered the abatement of the noise pollution.

the process of becoming acidic
Ocean acidification is a major environmental concern.

a woman's private sitting room or dressing room
She retired to her boudoir to prepare for the evening.

a small, low island or reef composed largely of sand or coral
The boat anchored near a small sandy cay.

the part of a church containing the altar and choir
The priest stood in the chancel during the service.

the Christian world; the worldwide body of Christians
Throughout Christendom, Christmas is a widely celebrated holiday.

the state of remaining in existence or operation
The continuance of the project depends on securing more funding.

a specific vineyard or wine classification, especially in France
This wine comes from a grand cru vineyard, known for its exceptional quality.

the theory of the evolution of species by natural selection
Darwinism profoundly influenced scientific thought in the 19th century.

a medical procedure involving a flexible tube with a camera to examine internal organs
The doctor recommended an endoscopy to examine her stomach and esophagus.

the quality of being fanatical; excessive enthusiasm or zeal
Religious fanaticism can sometimes lead to intolerance and conflict.
